basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and outdoor enthusiast from Lyon, France. Recently discovered the joys of kayaking and love to explore new games. Currently balancing a job in IT support with my passion for gaming and outdoor adventures. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to 11 PM local time. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends either paddling down a river or diving into virtual worlds. Not a fan of overly competitive environments but love a good challenge.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in IT support, I'm quite familiar with troubleshooting technical issues, which I often apply to gaming glitches and bugs. My knowledge is mostly self-taught, driven by curiosity and the need to solve problems efficiently. I also pick up new skills from online tutorials and community forums.
